approval.confirmation_reference: User requested continuous autonomous execution toward the frozen paper objective without repeated approvals.
approval.scope: One zero-training P0 shape contract using analytic scenes and 192 sparse rays from six fixed poses in one C01 training world; no C07/C10, graph or M-TARE.

purpose: Prove that one identity-preserving swept-superellipse schema can express ellipse, rounded rectangle and C1 mixed sections and remain valid for curved, sloped, tapered, branching and stacked geometry.

worlds.audit_scope: Only C01 graph, splines and geometry are read; C07 and C10 are declared only to prove exclusion.

raw_sources: Sealed C01 graph, splines and geometry parameters.
Deterministic analytic ellipse, rounded-rectangle, taper, curve/slope, T/Y/X, stacked-overlap and ambiguity scenes.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research audit of pinned procedural assets; no third-party redistribution.

sampling.independent_sampling_units: One C01 topology parent plus deterministic analytic micro-scenes; six real poses and 192 rays are implementation probes, not independent worlds.
sampling.rule: Run all 20 frozen analytic/unit contracts; lift all 55 C01 edge circles into the unified schema; cast exactly 32 fixed native angular samples from each of six fixed edge-midpoint poses at 0.05 m spacing.

split.historical_pollution_audit: No checkpoint, validation/test data, threshold, normalization, augmentation or planner output is read.

teacher.source: Finite centerline sweeps with endpoint half-width/half-height and shape exponent, cubic-smoothstep C1 endpoint interpolation, gravity-aligned local frames and identity-preserving free-space union.
teacher.valid_mask: Every ray hit returns the complete active operand set; multi-source hits are not converted to a unique label.
teacher.student_forbidden_inputs: Graph, world, edge/tunnel identity, absolute pose, mesh and future observations remain Teacher-only.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No model, graph builder, planner or closed-loop system is invoked.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.analytic: 20 tests pass and ellipse/rounded/mixed ray errors are <=0.02 m.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.continuity: Numeric endpoint derivative of all interpolated section parameters <=0.01.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.compatibility: Exactly 55 C01 identities lift with exact circle radii and exponent 2.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.real_probe: Exactly 192 rays, deterministic repeat, every hit source set nonempty.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only analytic and sparse C01 field audit

retention: Keep typed shape contract, metrics, tests, PNG/PDF/SVG method figure, logs, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
failure_policy: Any analytic error, continuity failure, identity/radius drift, empty hit provenance, nondeterminism or forbidden data access is FAIL. Do not tune after observing the formal result.
